messages:
maria: Heads-up — audit-router config pushed to prod ~02:30 added per-source write quotas. Seeing GPU pool node-prewarm failures in ap-south-1 with KMS decrypt errors, seems related to audit writes.
aj: Confirmed. 5 nodes failed to finish join in the last 8m. logs show 429 from audit-router when writing node-join events.
leo: Is this the new `audit-buffering` rollout? I toggled a couple flags in eu last week but didn't enable quotas there. @maria can you paste the exact error lines?
maria: ```
ERROR node-join: audit write failed status=429 body="quota_exceeded" path=/ingest/events src=ap-south-1 node=gpu-0a3f
WARN node-join: retrying write (backoff)
``` 
sre-bot: ALERT: GPU pool "ap-south-1" node join failures >= 4 in 10m. Auto-scaling paused to avoid thrash.
aj: This blocks warmup. If we spin replacements we'll pay for extra spots and still get cold-starts. Need a quick unblock before it affects SLAs.
leo: Short-term mitigations: (A) add audit-router allowlist for `event=join` from ap-south-1, or (B) bump quota for ap-south origin. Long-term: add local fallback buffer for join events when router returns 429.
ops-reviewer: I agree with temporary allowlist. I'll open a ticket and bump quota x5 for 30m while team patches the router. Also want an auditable IAM step for who performs the change.
maria: I'm working on a PR to the audit-router: 429->exponential backoff + write-to-local-disk buffer for join events. If we patch, we'll need a small deployment window (5 mins) and a config toggle.
aj: I'll draft a runbook command for the allowlist: `kubectl -n infra exec svc/audit-router -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/allowlist -d 'event=join&src=ap-south-1'` and instructions to increase quota in the infra console.
leo: I can execute the allowlist change but don't have `audit-router:admin` role. @ops-reviewer can you temporarily grant me permission? Also, ensure CloudTrail/console logs are captured for the change.
ops-reviewer: Granting `audit-router:admin` to leo for 1 hour now. Recording change in ticket INC-6421 and enabling extra retention for the audit topic. Please proceed and post confirmation.
maria: After the allowlist, nodes started joining again — confirmed 6/6 joined. Follow-ups: (1) revert allowlist after we ship router fix, (2) add a metric/alert for 429 surge on audit write path, (3) update oncall runbook to fallback-to-local-buffer.
aj: Quick cost note for postmortem: local buffer approach will add tiny disk cost ~0.12 USD/hr per node under heavy backpressure, vs minutes of cold-starts that can cost orders of magnitude more. Recommend documenting tradeoffs.
sre-bot: RESOLVED: alert cleared at 1732468010, auto-scaling resumed and warm pool back to target.
